record.question: If the system specifications are given in time domain, best approach for designing is
record.explanation: Time-domain specifications (rise time, overshoot, settling time) map directly to closed-loop pole locations, which the root locus technique plots against gain. Nyquist and Bode plots are frequency-domain tools, so options A and B are not the best approach.
